title: Sleep Quality Improvement
description: Poor sleep quality affecting crew performance and health.
ai: The Flight Engineer's sleep quality is below par, at 70 out of 100. Poor sleep can lead to fatigue and affect performance during waking hours [1][4]. It matters now because the next few nights in orbit are worth watching closely, and simple steps can help.
actions: Make sure the Flight Engineer gets a protected eight-hour sleep period.
Adjust the lighting to help the Flight Engineer's body clock stay on track.
Review sleep hygiene practices with the Flight Engineer.
Consider melatonin for the Flight Engineer, with the doctor's approval.
